points.description: States that bulb A is still in a closed/complete circuit (path) with the battery and switch Z, so current can flow through it. Equivalent wording accepted.

rubric.notes: Full mark for saying bulb A remains in a complete/closed path with the battery (via closed switch Z) so current flows. No mark for vague statements like "the circuit works" or "Z is closed" without reference to a complete path including the bulb.
